summary: Frontend-only verification of Street Vybz realistic-humans + LVMPD + LVFR + fire system fix. All 10 acceptance checks PASS. RPM avatars load (AVATARS.ready=true, male+female GLBs loaded, each with idle/walk/run clips). Character select works (clicked female -> playerSex='female'). 31 NPCs all have avatars, both sexes represented ('male','female'). CAR_TYPES.police.name='LVMPD CRUISER', CAR_TYPES.firetruck.name='LVFR ENGINE'. Setting S.wanted=2 spawns police (police.length=2). igniteCar creates fire with 7 flame meshes + point light; car.userData.burning=true. spawnFireTruck(0,0) yields fireTrucks.length=1 with mesh.userData.type='firetruck'. fireGun with player facing traffic car ignites it (traffic burning=true). Regression: gangs=2, taxi passengers (farewait)=3, pickups=9, career save writes runs=1. Renderer: shadowMap.enabled=true, toneMapping=ACESFilmicToneMapping(4), scene.environment set. Zero page errors. /api/games returns 5 core + 2 builder games; Street Vybz present, NO 'Carjack' anywhere. /games frontend renders Street Vybz card with the LVMPD/LVFR-mentioning description.
critical_code_review_comments: Game globals (AVATARS, S, npcs, traffic, police, fires, fireTrucks, CAR_TYPES, player, scene, renderer, THREE) are declared with const/let inside a classic <script> block, so they are NOT attached to window (main agent's context note incorrectly stated they were). They ARE reachable inside page.evaluate as free identifiers because classic scripts share the realm's script-scope. This currently works for automated testing but is fragile — recommend explicitly attaching key game APIs to window (window.__streets = { start, gameOver, igniteCar, spawnFireTruck, fireGun, AVATARS, S, ... }) so external testing/console tooling doesn't rely on lexical-scope leakage.

index.html is a very large single file (>1300 lines). Consider extracting avatar loading (loadAvatars/makeAvatarPed), fire system (igniteCar/updateFires), and LVMPD/LVFR car logic into separate modules for maintainability.

GLB assets are large (~1-2MB each) and initial load takes 9-11s. Consider showing a loading progress UI on the start screen keyed off AVATARS.ready so users don't click 'start' before RPM humans are hydrated.
seed_data_creation: None. Career save wrote {runs:1} into localStorage as expected part of test.

Wait >=11s after page load for RPM GLBs to finish. .charBtn[data-sex='male'|'female'] on start screen.
